'''Najee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pydyrian]] who served as the portmaster on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]] in [[44 ABY]]. During [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] mission to hunt [[Abeloth]], he and his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], along with the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]], landed on Pydyr despite an ongoing outbreak of an epidemic&mdash;although the epidemic was in actuality an [[Mind trick/Legends#Force illusion|illusion]] in the [[White Current/Legends|White Current]], caused by Abeloth herself. Luke sought Najee and his subordinate [[Sanar]]'s cooperation in providing information on Abeloth's location, and succeeded when Sanar disobeyed Najee's order and guided Luke to Abeloth's location.<ref name="FOTJ: Vortex" />
